evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 435-443 °C, physically implausible versus all other column temperatures at 63-76 °C, and drifts steadily upward
Slow oscillating/travelling temperature waves rather than a settled profile
Reflux and distillate flows near zero and erratic (0.0-2.1 L/h) while FYI702 stays ~6-7, inconsistent with the measured flows
